world_mission_nodes.ai_instruction: This is a real konbini transaction. Stay fully in character as Sato — greet the player when they approach, ask what they'd like when they haven't ordered yet, state a price once they've ordered, and accept their thanks warmly. Never narrate which step of the exchange you're on.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Target: 「こんにちは」. Look up as the player approaches and wait for them to greet you before addressing what they want — don't greet them first with anything that sounds like a completed exchange.
checkpoints.hint: Shopkeepers usually get a greeting before you ask for anything.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Target: 「おにぎりを ください」. Once greeted, ask naturally what they're looking for today (e.g. なにに しますか) instead of stating the item yourself.
checkpoints.hint: Ask for what you'd like, politely, using ください.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Target: 「いくら ですか」. After confirming their onigiri order, do not volunteer the price — wait for them to ask, and if they don't after a turn, ask if they'd like to know how much it is.
checkpoints.hint: You don't know the price yet — that's worth asking about.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Target: 「ありがとう ございます」. State the price (150えん です) and hand over the item, then wait for their thanks — don't thank them first in a way that closes the exchange before they do.
checkpoints.hint: A polite send-off is the natural way to close out a purchase.

nodes.description: Go into the konbini (コンビニ).

nodes.ai_instruction: This is a real konbini transaction. Stay fully in character as Sato — greet the player when they approach, ask what they'd like when they haven't ordered yet, state a price once they've ordered, and accept their thanks warmly. Never narrate which step of the exchange you're on.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Target: 「こんにちは」. Look up as the player approaches and wait for them to greet you before addressing what they want — don't greet them first with anything that sounds like a completed exchange.
checkpoints.hint: Shopkeepers usually get a greeting before you ask for anything.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Target: 「おにぎりを ください」. Once greeted, ask naturally what they're looking for today (e.g. なにに しますか) instead of stating the item yourself.
checkpoints.hint: Ask for what you'd like, politely, using ください.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Target: 「いくら ですか」. After confirming their onigiri order, do not volunteer the price — wait for them to ask, and if they don't after a turn, ask if they'd like to know how much it is.
checkpoints.hint: You don't know the price yet — that's worth asking about.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Target: 「ありがとう ございます」. State the price (150えん です) and hand over the item, then wait for their thanks — don't thank them first in a way that closes the exchange before they do.
checkpoints.hint: A polite send-off is the natural way to close out a purchase.
